title: sentinel-lint configuration
description: Configuration for the .sentinelrc.json file read by sentinel-lint.

failOn.description: Lowest severity that makes the CLI exit with code 1.

include.description: When non-empty, only paths matching one of these globs are scanned.

exclude.description: Paths matching one of these globs are skipped.

rules.description: Per rule severity overrides. The value off disables the rule.

plugins.description: Rule modules to load, resolved relative to this file.

maxFileSize.description: Files larger than this many bytes are skipped.

maxFiles.description: Stop the walk after this many readable text files.
